newsitem.title: UK: BFI up nine as capers, panamaxes strengthen.
newsitem.headline: BFI up nine as capers, panamaxes strengthen.

text.p: The Baltic Freight Index (BFI) up nine to 1,459.
Brokers reported stronger conditions for capers and panamaxes in the Far East with the Taiwan-Indian Ocean area particularly firm.
Period timecharter business from 2-4 upto 12 months has been covered by a number of charterers at between $10,000 and about $12,000 depending on qualtiy of vessel.
Pacific-Australian rounds were being fixed in the region of $12,000 daily or more for modern vessels.
At 1300 GMT BIFFEX was between 20 to three points higher and turnover totalled 75 lots.
